title: dep-scan vdb info output
description: The document `depscan vdb info --format json` writes on stdout: the local database and shard store as a read-only inspection records them. A missing database, a stale shard or a coverage gap is recorded as such, never hidden. The paths in vdbHome and shardStore.storeDir are absolute with / separators; the marker is the last download's image reference or shard-set marker, not a path.

vdbHome.description: The VDB_HOME directory, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform.

marker.description: The last download marker: an image reference for a complete flavor, or a shards marker naming the refreshed shard set. Null when nothing was ever downloaded.

markerKind.description: What kind of marker the last download wrote.

flavor.description: The published flavor name read from the image marker, or null when the marker names no known flavor, names shards, or is missing.

metadataRows.description: Rows in the metadata tables. Zero unless the extended flavor is installed.

extendedFlavor.description: Whether the metadata tables are populated, which is what the extended flavors add.

mainDb.description: The main database as its build metadata records it, or null when no database was found.

builtUtc.description: When the database was built, as the metadata records it. Null when the metadata is unreadable.

stale.description: Whether the database is past the VDB_AGE_HOURS window.

maxAgeHours.description: The VDB_AGE_HOURS window this installation uses.

completeness.description: full for a complete flavor, partial for a shard installed as the main database, which under-reports outside its scope.

dataRows.description: Rows in the cve_data tables at build time, or the string ? when the metadata does not say.

indexRows.description: Rows in the cve_index tables at build time, or the string ? when the metadata does not say.

storeDir.description: The shard store directory, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform.

coverage.description: full when every group shard is present, otherwise partial with the missing shards named.

mixedBuilds.description: Whether the installed shards come from more than one build.

missingGroupShards.description: The purl types with no local shard. They are reported as coverage gaps at search time, never silently skipped.

name.description: The shard name in the local store.

buildId.description: The build the shard came from.

builtUtc.description: When the shard was built, or null when the store does not say.

ageDays.description: The shard's age in days, or null when the store does not say.

typeCount.description: How many purl types the shard holds.

types.description: The purl types the shard holds.

stale.description: Whether the shard is much older than its siblings, which a refresh should fix.
